body_markdown:
The playlist you made for the trip. The podcast you’re halfway through. The audiobook you’ve been meaning to start. Thanks to our partnership with United Airlines, you’ll be able to listen to all of those and more—directly from your seatback screen, logged into your own Spotify account.


Our


[partnership with United](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-06-05/united-airlines-partnership-inflight-entertainment-music-audiobooks-podcasts/) is hitting new heights. Last year, we brought a curated selection of Spotify content to United seatbacks. Now, we’re bringing personal Spotify account streaming to those seatback displays for the first time. Rolling out on United’s Starlink-equipped aircraft, Spotify listeners can scan a QR code to securely log in at 35,000 feet—unlocking their personalized Home feed, saved playlists, Your Library, and features like DJ and music videos. You can even check out flagship playlists like


[Today’s Top Hits](https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DXcBWIGoYBM5M?si=976d0f0e402a420e) or


[New Music Friday](https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DX4JAvHpjipBk?si=aed9a838edeb4225) the moment fresh tracks drop mid-flight.


Spotify audio keeps playing while you browse other seatback features, including the flight map, and a small on-screen player lets you control playback without returning to the Spotify app.


“Bringing personal Spotify accounts to United seatback screens is a major milestone, creating a new way to experience Spotify in flight,” said


**Ian Geller** , VP of Business Development at Spotify. “With a quick QR code scan, passengers can bring their personalized Spotify experience to the screen in front of them—their recommendations, saved library, and favorite songs, podcasts, audiobooks, and videos—and enjoy it all on a big screen at 35,000 feet.”


## **How to log in**


On a flight offering the new Spotify functionality, getting started is easy:


****


-


1. **Connect your phone to the “United” WiFi network.** You don’t need a WiFi pass or to sign in to MileagePlus to use Spotify on the seatback.


2. **Tap the Spotify icon or tile on your seatback screen** and scan the QR code with your phone’s camera.


3. **Confirm pairing on your phone.** If you’re already logged in to Spotify, your account will connect automatically. Otherwise, you’ll be prompted to log in or sign up on your phone.


[https://storage.googleapis.com/pr-newsroom-wp/1/2026/11/Spotify-x-United-Demo-Videosmaller23402394.mp4](https://storage.googleapis.com/pr-newsroom-wp/1/2026/11/Spotify-x-United-Demo-Videosmaller23402394.mp4)


Once connected, you can open Spotify on your seatback screen to pick up right where you left off—whether that’s resuming a video podcast, browsing Your Library, or checking out tailored recommendations. You can interact directly with the seatback touch display, or optionally use your phone as a companion remote to browse titles and control playback without leaning forward in your seat.


Your Spotify login details are never entered on the seatback screen. At the end of the flight, you’ll be automatically logged out, and the screen will be reset before the next passengers board. You can also log out yourself at any time from the Spotify app on the seatback screen.


Both Spotify Free and Premium listeners can use the app, with playback options and features depending on their plan and market.


## **When you’ll find it on your flight**


The new functionality is rolling out across United Starlink-equipped aircraft now and will expand to additional aircraft through 2027.


Don’t see the app on your flight yet? The Spotify channel we introduced last year is available across United’s fleet. With this, travelers can listen to


[450 hours](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-06-05/united-airlines-partnership-inflight-entertainment-music-audiobooks-podcasts/) of curated playlists, podcasts, and audiobooks on their seatback screens for free.
